name: messagebox
description: The hosted BRC-33 messagebox: one skein keeps a mailbox for every key it hosts (the keys of config.messagebox.index's record, onboard/index in a host skein). POST /messagebox/sendMessage (kernel.brc104, then the filter hosted: the recipient a hosted key, else 403 ERR_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED, nothing logged) stores the message and adds it to {recipient, box}'s list in the request's step; POST /messagebox/acknowledgeMessage (kernel.brc104) removes ids from the caller's own lists in its step; POST /messagebox/listMessages (kernel.brc104, then the filter list) is a read: the caller's box, nothing logged. JSON (BRC-33) or dag-cbor (BRC-231, application/cbor).
